correctness.rationale: The prior exact resolvent expression P_n(eta)=B(eta)+C_n(eta) is explicitly credited to Riberi arXiv:2605.08056v4 Eq.15. Integrand C_n-C_{n+1}=(2eta/pi)int_0^1 q^{2n-2}(1-q²)^2/(1+eta²q²)dq>0 gives strict spatial decrease. In t=log eta, B=(1/pi)int sin(k)/(cosh(t)+sin(k))dk has its unique maximum t=0 and B_tt(0)=-2/(3pi), independently confirmed by quadrature. Derivative C_n wrt eta is positive through eta<=1, forcing all finite maximizers >1. For n>=2, endpoint values vanish and an interior maximizer exists; for n=1, the C1 substitution proves probability tends to 1 at eta=infinity. Uniform O(n^-2) bounds on C_n and its first two t derivatives plus strict bulk maximum yield eventual unique global maximizer. Its slope C_n,t(0)=1/(2pi n³)+O(n^-4), reproduced numerically at n=12,24,48,96, gives t*=3/(4n³)+O(n^-4), eta*=1+3/(4n³)+O(n^-4). Finite quadrature only corroborates these analytic integral and beta arguments.
